RAILWAY_DOCKERFILE_PATH.description: Build the lightweight companion gateway rather than the full Sushi application.

GATEWAY_ONLY.description: Serve the persistent WebSocket gateway, not the Sushi frontend.

NODE_ENV.description: Run the gateway in production mode.

HOST.description: Listen on the container network interface for Railway's HTTP proxy.

PORT.description: Gateway listen and public-networking target port.

GUACD_HOST.description: Private hostname of the guacd service in this template; do not expose guacd publicly.

GUACD_PORT.description: Private guacd protocol port for live RDP.

ALLOWED_ORIGIN.description: Exact HTTPS origin of your Sushi frontend, without a path or trailing slash. Change for a different frontend.

SUSHI_GATEWAY_TOKEN.description: Railway generates a 48-character hex token for each new template deployment. Copy it privately into Sushi Gateway settings; do not seal it until you have saved a secure copy.

SUSHI_GATEWAY_TOKEN_REQUIRE_HEX_48.description: On updated gateway code, refuse startup if the template token is missing or not 48 lowercase hex characters. This checks format, not randomness.
